text: The Divergence Theorem states that the outward flux of F through a closed surface equals:
choices: the line integral of F around a boundary curve
the volume integral of curl F over the enclosed region
the volume integral of div F over the enclosed region
the surface area of the closed surface
explanation: Gauss's Divergence Theorem equates outward flux through a closed surface to the integral of the divergence over the enclosed volume. The curl version is not even dimensionally sensible here (curl is a vector), and flux is unrelated to raw surface area.
